All five producer executable/result archives, netlists, validation logs and numerical ensembles are unacquired. No producer replay, physical measurement/device, global fault tolerance, practical advantage or historical priority established. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

body: Different complete fault strings yield different triangular symplectic characters of the actual Bell words; character orthogonality cancels cross terms only at final coarse decoding. The logical register remains framed until the consumer acts. A raw-word-controlled next source invalidates the character argument. Clifford covariance is essential; T does not preserve a Pauli-only ledger. A classical one-time pad hides its ciphertext but cannot undo raw record leakage already present in the bath.
